name: Inshopa (local development)
description: The /products command lists this shop’s published catalog for anyone. Uses the verified local API at 127.0.0.1:8080, suitable for the WSL Linux preview. Purchase alerts are pending the sales API. Android needs a separate package version with a reachable HTTPS API URL.

setupFields.label: Inshopa API key
setupFields.helpText: A key with storefront:read permission for this shop.

setupFields.label: Storefront URL
setupFields.helpText: The exact registered shop origin including its scheme and development port. This supplies Origin and X-Storefront-Host.
